title: Change of Service Model Terms Across the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
| Service model | Change notice (calendar days) | Downgrade cooldown (months) | Change administration fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 30 | 6 | 750.00 |
| Limited Service Cafe | 45 | 9 | 1650.00 |
| Full Service Cafe | 60 | 12 | 3900.00 |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 90 | 12 | 7800.00 |
| Executive Dining Service | 60 | 12 | 5400.00 |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 120 | 18 | 14500.00 |

This table fixes, for each service model a site may hold under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, the calendar days of notice required before a change of service model takes effect, the months that must pass after a change of service model before a downgrade is accepted, and the administration fee charged for a change of service model, in USD.

Distinguishing the models:
- The change notice period lengthens with the scale of the service model, from 30 calendar days at Grab & Go Cafe Service to 120 calendar days at Campus Dining Commons Service.
- The downgrade cooldown reaches its ceiling of 12 months at Full Service Cafe and stays at 12 months for Culinary Center Cafe and Executive Dining Service alike, before extending further to 18 months only at Campus Dining Commons Service.
- The change administration fee is the figure that separates the models most sharply: Executive Dining Service, at 5400.00 USD, sits above Full Service Cafe at 3900.00 USD despite sharing the same change notice period and the same downgrade cooldown, and Campus Dining Commons Service, at 14500.00 USD, carries the highest fee this table records.

Hypothetically, a site currently held under Limited Service Cafe that changed its service model would, by this table, give 45 calendar days of notice for that change to take effect, pay a change administration fee of 1650.00 USD, and, if the change were a downgrade, wait 9 months from that change before a further downgrade is accepted.
